description: React functional component 'NoteAttributes' that displays metadata about a note, including word count, character count, paragraph count, read time, last modified date, creation date, and note UUID. It utilizes utility functions for formatting dates, calculating read time, and counting note attributes.

classes.name: NoteAttributes
classes.description: A React FunctionComponent that displays various attributes and metadata for a note, such as word count, read time, modification dates, and identifier.
